content: Bitwarden separates 'login' (server auth) from 'unlock' (local vault decryption). Login: client derives masterKey via Argon2id/PBKDF2 from password+salt, derives second-stage master password hash sent to POST /identity/connect/token (OAuth2 password grant) -- server verifies hash, never sees masterKey/password. Response: JWT access_token (short-lived, sstamp claim), refresh_token, encrypted userKey (wrapped by masterKey), Kdf/KdfIterations params. Unlock: purely client-side decrypt of userKey using masterKey; server not involved. Maps to PRF unlock: WebAuthn assertion verification = login (issues session token); PRF -> HKDF -> unwrap UK = unlock (fully local, server blind).
